Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ManageItemCRUDService::createItem(barcode: Integer,name: String,price: Real,stocknumber: Integer,orderprice: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingItem: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		let newItem: Item in
		newItem.oclIsNew() and
		existingItem.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		Item.allInstance()->includes(newItem) and
		newItem.Barcode = barcode and
		newItem.Name = name and
		newItem.Price = price and
		newItem.StockNumber = stocknumber and
		newItem.OrderPrice = orderprice and
		result = true or
		existingItem.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		existingItem.Barcode = barcode and
		existingItem.Name = name and
		existingItem.Price = price and
		existingItem.StockNumber = stocknumber and
		existingItem.OrderPrice = orderprice and
		result = true
}
